svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Agent Countercheck is a referee, not another AI agent
svg.desc: Left: the AI agent (Claude Code, Hermes, Cursor) does the work: it thinks, writes code and says done, and it can be wrong or take shortcuts. Right: Countercheck is a plain program with no AI model. It runs your own commands from the locked check file and writes a sealed receipt. Exam analogy: the agent is the student, Countercheck is the teacher marking the paper, your tests are the exam, and the student can't rewrite the questions.
svg.text: THE AI AGENT DOES THE WORK
Claude Code · Hermes · Cursor · Cortex Code
thinks, plans, uses an AI model
can be wrong, or take a shortcut:
skip a test, edit it, never run it
A plain program, like git or pytest
✓ no AI model: nothing to fool or persuade
✓ runs YOUR commands: tests, linters, builds
✓ rules locked before the agent started
✓ same input, same verdict, every time
✓ writes a sealed receipt of what ran
agent = student · your tests = the exam · Countercheck = the teacher marking it
The student never marks their own paper, and can't rewrite the questions halfway through.
